info.title: Flowgate API
info.description: Unified private-capital pipeline: classification, extraction, configurable compliance (traditional + Islamic), ledger.

get.description: Serve the React app at the root URL, falling back to the legacy demo.

schema.title: Response Get Instrument Ledger Instruments  Instrument Id  Ledger Get

post.description:
Real-document intake: PDF / TXT / MD / HTML / image upload. The
file's embedded text layer is read first; scans fall back to Tesseract
OCR (the accepted MVP trade-off, stated in app.ocr). Everything
downstream -- classification, extraction, compliance, ledger -- is the
same pipeline the text endpoint feeds. Unparseable documents fail loudly
(422) with the reason; the pipeline never guesses.

Attach a supporting document (fatwa, KYC, side letter) that the
compliance gateway needs to see as evidence, without running it through
extraction -- there is no structured schema to extract a fatwa into, and
forcing one through the same pipeline as loan/sukuk documents would
either misclassify it or route it to review for the wrong reason.

get.description:
Picker list for the proposal review UI: when a proposal's subscriber
is unresolved, the reviewer links one of *these* known investors to it --
the holder on a cap-table event must always be a real Investor row.

post.description:
Record an investor's stake in an instrument. Both sides must exist --
no silent dangling references into the portfolio.

get.description:
The cross-fund view: every holding an investor has, across funds and
across both compliance tracks, with per-track exposure totals -- the same
unification thesis as the compliance gateway, on the investor side.

schema.title: Response List Valuations Valuations  Issuer Name  Get

get.description:
The current valuation of a given type, as of now (or an explicit
date). Staleness is a nag, not a block: a 409A older than 12 months
still floors strike prices until a new valuation is recorded.

schema.title: Response List Convertibles Convertibles  Issuer Name  Get

post.description:
Compute what a priced round would convert for an issuer's outstanding
SAFEs -- without persisting anything. The commit endpoint (Phase 3.5)
re-runs the same math inside a single transaction.

schema.title: Response List Priced Rounds Priced Rounds  Issuer Name  Get

post.description:
Read-only help assistant. Never writes. Never claims compliance.

The question is answered from the repo's markdown plans, loaded once
and cached. Issuer context is accepted but unused in v1.

Prepare a cap-table issuance proposal from a processed document.

The document must have passed both confidence gates (classification >=
0.75, extraction >= 0.85) -- a reviewed/unprocessed document carries
numbers nobody validated, so it can never seed a proposal. The proposal
itself is inert: no Security, Investor, or CapTableEvent rows exist until
a human approves (see the approval endpoint below).

The human gate. Materializes the proposed issuance as a real
CapTableEvent -- the ONLY path from an extracted document into the
cap table, matching how CapitalCall approval already works.

schema.title: Response Approve Cap Table Proposal Cap Table Proposals  Proposal Id  Approve Post

post.description:
Resolve an unresolved subscriber: attach a REAL investor to a pending
proposal. This is the remedy the approval gate's 409 message promises --
extraction can transcribe a subscriber the document names, but when the
document only carries a signature block, the human decides *who* this
position belongs to, and the cap table only ever issues to an investor
row that exists. Only a PROPOSED (undecided) proposal can be edited;
the link (and who did it) lands in the audit ledger.

get.description:
Review queue for the human approval gate (newest first).

``?status=proposed`` shows only the pending decisions; omit it to see
recent approvals/rejections as well. This is what the UI's proposals
panel renders -- a proposal only ever becomes shares when a named human
approves it, so this queue is the single place to see what awaits.

schema.title: Response List Cap Table Proposals Cap Table Proposals Get

post.description:
The other half of the human gate. A named reviewer rejects the
proposal: nothing is written to the cap table, the proposal is marked
REJECTED, and the decision lands in the audit ledger. A rejected
proposal can never be approved afterwards -- the path forward is a new
proposal from a corrected document.

Create a capital call notice (extracted data) pending approval.

The funder_name is matched against the Investor registry by name; if found,
the funder_id is resolved at creation time. If not found, funder_id stays
NULL and the call is flagged ``funder_unresolved`` -- the reviewer is told
to create the investor before approving (same semantics as the
``subscriber_unresolved`` flag on cap-table proposals).

Named-reviewer approve/reject gate for a capital call.

Mirrors the cap-table proposal gate: a call is PENDING_APPROVAL until
a human reviewer confirms it. Rejects write a ledger entry but no cap-table
event -- capital calls track cash obligations, not ownership facts.

A fully unresolved funder (no Investor row at all) blocks approval with
409. A PROVISIONAL investor (created by the system from a name-match) is
linkable -- the reviewer sees the flag and decides.

get.description:
Review queue for capital calls.

``?status=`` filters to a single lifecycle state (e.g. ``pending_approval``
for the call queue). Omit the filter to see all calls across all states.
Each call carries ``funder_name`` resolved from the registry at read time.

schema.title: Response List Capital Calls Capital Calls Get

get.description:
Calls whose ``due_date`` has passed and that are still ``PENDING_APPROVAL``.

``?as_of=`` lets the caller evaluate overdue-ness against an arbitrary point
in time (useful for backfill / reconciliation). Defaults to *now*.

schema.title: Response List Overdue Capital Calls Capital Calls Overdue Get

get.description: Payments recorded against a capital call, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Capital Call Payments Capital Calls  Call Id  Payments Get

post.description:
Record a payment received against an APPROVED capital call.

Gates: the call must exist (404) and be ``approved`` (409) -- payment on
a pending or rejected call is refused, the money story follows the
approval story. The payment may not exceed the call's remaining balance
(409): extra cash is never silently absorbed, a real overpayment needs a
human to look at the bank statement and act deliberately. Currency must
match the call's currency (409) -- no implicit FX in the ledger.

get.description:
List active rules as of a date. Defaults to today.

Returns the latest version per (package_name, rule_name) whose
effective window includes as_of.

schema.title: Response List Compliance Rules Compliance Rules Get

post.description:
Create a new version of a compliance rule.

If an active version exists for (package_name, rule_name), it is
superseded: effective_to is set to the new rule's
effective_from minus one day, and the new row receives
version = previous.version + 1. The previous row is never
deleted -- governance history stays interpretable.

The new rule's effective_from must be strictly after the
current version's effective_from. Two versions cannot share
an effective_from -- that would create ambiguity in the
loader's ordering.

get.description: Full version history for a rule, newest first.

schema.title: Response Compliance Rule History Compliance Rules  Package Name   Rule Name  Get

post.description:
Deactivate a single rule version.

The row is never deleted -- audit history stays intact. A
deactivated row is skipped by load_rule_sets and by
list_compliance_rules.

Create a governance rule scoped to an issuer. 400 on an unknown
rule_type or a malformed condition bag -- a broken rule must never
reach the evaluation loop (the engine fails closed on unparseable
conditions at evaluation time, but garbage is stopped at the door).

get.description:
All rules (active and inactive -- history must stay interpretable),
newest first, optionally scoped to one issuer.

schema.title: Response List Transfer Rules Transfer Rules Get

get.description:
Gate decisions, newest first. ``?outcome=pending`` is the review
queue; every pending row carries its derived ``overdue`` flag so the
UI never recomputes escalation differently from the server.

schema.title: Response List Transfer Evaluations Transfer Evaluations Get

post.description:
Approve a PENDING evaluation and write its transfer event.

The event is re-validated against the *current* ledger (overdraft
replay), so shares that moved between proposal and decision are
caught here, not silently written. On failure the event is rolled
back and the evaluation stays PENDING for a corrected decision.

Reject a PENDING evaluation. Nothing is written to the cap table;
the rejection itself is recorded on the evaluation and in the ledger.

get.description:
Distinct issuer names that currently exist. Used by the Cap Table
tab's issuer picker so a user can switch between real issuers without
typing an exact name.

schema.title: Response List Webhook Subscriptions Webhooks Get
Response List Deliveries Webhooks  Subscription Id  Deliveries Get
Response Send Test Event Webhooks  Subscription Id  Test Post
Response Retry Delivery Webhooks Deliveries  Delivery Id  Retry Post

get.description: Serve the React app for any unmatched route (SPA client-side routing).

CapTableProposalOut.title: CapTableProposalOut
CapTableProposalOut.description: A prepared (inert) cap-table issuance from a processed document.

CapitalCallCreate.title: CapitalCallCreate
CapitalCallCreate.description:
Request body for creating a capital call notice from an extracted
document. Mirrors the fields on CapitalCallExtraction.

CapitalCallOut.title: CapitalCallOut
CapitalCallOut.description: Read-side view of a CapitalCall, used by the review queue.

CapitalCallReviewRequest.title: CapitalCallReviewRequest
CapitalCallReviewRequest.description: Request body for the capital-call approval gate (Phase A).

CapitalCallStatus.title: CapitalCallStatus
CapitalCallStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a capital call ingestion. The system never moves money
on its own: an extracted call is PENDING_APPROVAL until a human reviewer
confirms it through the approval gate.

ComplianceRuleCreate.title: ComplianceRuleCreate
ComplianceRuleCreate.description:
Payload to create a new version of a compliance rule.

The route performs the versioned write: if an active version
exists for (package_name, rule_name), its effective_to is set
to this payload's effective_from minus one day, and the new
row receives version = previous.version + 1. Otherwise version
starts at 1.

DocumentSubmit.title: DocumentSubmit
DocumentSubmit.description:
MVP intake: raw text, not a file upload -- OCR/file handling is a
separate, already-built concern (app/ocr.py) this endpoint can grow into
without changing its shape.

EvidenceDocumentSubmit.title: EvidenceDocumentSubmit
EvidenceDocumentSubmit.description:
For supporting/evidence documents (fatwas, KYC, side letters) that the
compliance gateway needs *attached and typed*, not extracted -- there is
no LoanExtraction-style schema for a fatwa, and there shouldn't be one.

LatestValuationOut.title: LatestValuationOut
LatestValuationOut.description:
The current valuation of a given type, plus the compliance nag: a
409A older than 12 months is stale (warning only, never a block).

PaymentCreate.title: PaymentCreate
PaymentCreate.description:
Request body for recording a payment against an APPROVED capital
call (Phase C). ``recorded_by`` is a named human -- same audit rule as
every other gate; the endpoint refuses anonymous receipts.

PaymentOut.title: PaymentOut
PaymentOut.description: Read-side view of a recorded CapitalCallPayment.

PipelineUploadOut.title: PipelineUploadOut
PipelineUploadOut.description:
PipelineRunOut plus the text the system actually read from the
uploaded file -- transparency about what was parsed, and it lets the
client re-run review flows (attach-fatwa-and-recheck) without
re-uploading.

PortfolioHoldingOut.title: PortfolioHoldingOut
PortfolioHoldingOut.description:
One row in a cross-fund portfolio view -- the holding plus enough of
the underlying instrument to be useful without a second round trip.

PricedRoundCreate.title: PricedRoundCreate
PricedRoundCreate.description:
Commit terms for a priced round (Phase 3.5). ``pre_safe_shares`` and
``options_pool`` must match the values used in the preview -- the commit
re-runs the same conversion math inside a single transaction.

PricedRoundPreviewRequest.title: PricedRoundPreviewRequest
PricedRoundPreviewRequest.description: Terms for a what-if conversion run. Nothing is persisted.

ShariahReviewStatus.title: ShariahReviewStatus
ShariahReviewStatus.description:
Replaces the bare bool. The system may only ever set
SYSTEM_FLAGGED_NONCOMPLIANT or PENDING_SCHOLAR_REVIEW.

SCHOLAR_APPROVED and SCHOLAR_REJECTED are *human-only* transitions and
are enforced by the model validator / human-review context in
``app.models.review``.

TransferEvaluationOut.title: TransferEvaluationOut
TransferEvaluationOut.description:
Read-side view of one gate decision. ``overdue`` is *derived* at
read time (pending AND older than the rule's escalation_after_days) --
the same derivation-only pattern as the Phase B overdue badge; it is
never stored.

TransferRuleCreate.title: TransferRuleCreate
TransferRuleCreate.description:
Request body for creating a governance rule scoped to an issuer.

``condition`` is a typed JSON bag keyed by ``rule_type`` (validated by
app.transfer_rules.validate_rule_condition -- unknown keys ride along
verbatim so future rule types never need a migration).

TransferRuleOut.title: TransferRuleOut
TransferRuleOut.description: Read-side view of a TransferRule (active and inactive both).
